name: Shōnai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shōnai town emblem in green, orange and blue: green stylised leaves with a blue stroke beneath an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Shōnai, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 2005.

features.role: Shōnai town emblem — green stylised leaves with a blue stroke beneath an orange disc
